in_marathi.name: Kanhiyalal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Krishna's Yard
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanhiyalal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Kanhiyalal' is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Kanh’ which means Lord Krishna and ‘Yaal’ which means yard or abode. This name signifies that the person is residing in the abode of Lord Krishna or is protected by him.
